title: Bump quest-cli to 0.5.0 (wave 3 release prep, lockstep with lore 0.5.0)
description: Wave 3 of the fleet backlog campaign (OPAG-64/65). opum-agent's instruction (2026-09-08): step 1 of wave 3 is a release-prep PR that bumps every manifest and plugin.json to 0.5.0 and writes a changelog section stating the 0.4.x -> 0.5.0 jump is the lockstep version sync with lore 0.5.0, not a breaking change, listing everything dev holds since 0.4.0 (QCLI-228, 219, 221, 215, 243, 244, 163, 226, 168, 134). On dev only -- no tag, no promotion, no publish. opum-cli-e2e will qualify this dev tip and lore-cli's together as the release-candidate pair; the tag/publish follow on green, behind the user's authorization, as with 0.4.0.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Version bumped across every hand-edited location: package.json (version + all six optionalDependencies), .claude-plugin/plugin.json, src/application/version.ts (QUEST_VERSION), src/contract/tracker/index.ts (QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION only -- MIN_QUEST_VERSION stays a floor, untouched), fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json, CLAUDE.md's managed agent-instructions block (regenerated via quest agents --update-instructions, not hand-edited)

All six platform binaries rebuilt locally with the pinned Bun version before any commit (matching the 0.4.0 precedent), with package.json's questPlatformPackages checksums and each npm/quest-*/package.json's questBinarySha256 recomputed from the rebuilt bytes
bun.lock regenerated; bun run check:packages, bun run test:packages, and bun run check all green
A CHANGELOG.md entry for 0.5.0 explains the version jump is a lockstep sync with lore 0.5.0, not a breaking change, and lists every task landed since 0.4.0
Landed on dev only via a normal PR with required checks green -- no tag pushed, no dev-to-main promotion attempted, no publish workflow run

implementationNotes: All hand-edited version locations bumped to 0.5.0: package.json (version + all six optionalDependencies), .claude-plugin/plugin.json, src/application/version.ts (QUEST_VERSION), src/contract/tracker/index.ts (QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION only -- confirmed MIN_QUEST_VERSION untouched via grep, it stays a floor at 0.1.0), fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json. CLAUDE.md's managed block regenerated via quest agents --update-instructions --target claude (not hand-edited), now reads 'Quest CLI 0.5.0'. All six platform binaries rebuilt locally with the pinned Bun 1.3.14 (matching packageManager) via bun run build:packages before any commit; package.json's questPlatformPackages checksums and each npm/quest-*/package.json's questBinarySha256 were recomputed by that same script from the rebuilt bytes. bun.lock regenerated via bun install. bun run check:packages and bun run test:packages both green (silent success); bun run check: 430/430 tests green, typecheck/lint/format/layer-check clean. CHANGELOG.md added with a 0.5.0 entry stating the version jump is the lockstep sync with lore 0.5.0, not a breaking change, and listing all ten campaign items landed since 0.4.0 (QCLI-228, 219, 221, 215, 243, 244, 163, 226, 168, 134), cross-checked against git log 43441cc..dev. Staging the ~500MB of rebuilt binaries hit severe host memory pressure (git add repeatedly SIGKILL'd, exit 137, unrelated to this repo -- traced to another process, not this session's own work); resolved once the user freed memory, then staged one platform at a time successfully. Landing on dev only: no tag, no promotion to main, no publish workflow run.

Landed on dev via PR #311, merge SHA 45cc742 -- fast-forward, no tag pushed, no dev-to-main promotion attempted, no publish workflow run. Both required checks (source-gates, operating block digest) green; the six-platform projection matrix also passed.
finalSummary: quest-cli bumped from 0.4.0 to 0.5.0 on dev, dev-only per opum-agent's wave 3 step 1 instruction -- no tag, no promotion, no publish. All hand-edited version locations updated, six platform binaries rebuilt locally with the pinned Bun 1.3.14, package/platform checksums recomputed from the rebuilt bytes, bun.lock and CLAUDE.md's managed block regenerated. CHANGELOG.md added, framing the jump as the lockstep version sync with lore 0.5.0 (not a breaking change) and listing all ten wave 1-2 campaign items. Landed via PR #311, merge SHA 45cc742, both required checks green. Hit a genuine host memory-pressure blocker staging the ~500MB of rebuilt binaries (unrelated to this repo); resolved once the user freed memory, staged one platform at a time.
